exposure: true knot of the umbilical cord (TKUC)
True knot of the umbilical cord (TKUC)
Singletons born beyond 22 weeks gestational age with TKUC
weekly fetal heart rate monitoring(FHRM) ≥ 30 weeks
Mode of delivery management (active vs. routine)
outcome: Instrumental delivery due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate
cohort: Singletons born beyond 22 weeks gestational age with TKUC
finding: Active management (weekly fetal heart rate monitoring and labor induction at 36-37 weeks) for true knot of the umbilical cord did not reduce neonatal asphyxia compared to routine management.
mod_finding: Active management was associated with higher rates of cesarean section and induced prematurity compared to routine management.
